dataset: IBM AMLworld HI-Small (Altman et al., NeurIPS 2023 Datasets & Benchmarks), Kaggle ealtman2019/ibm-transactions-for-anti-money-laundering-aml
note: Generic laundering patterns from the AMLworld generator, NOT Czech money-mule schemes. Placeholder FX table. Hand-set weights.

split.rule: labels of the calibration window are used for exactly one choice (the flag threshold); weights are hand-set; the held-out window was never used for any choice; 'full' contains the calibration days and is labelled so
split.features_per_window: features are computed only from rows inside the window

threshold.rule: argmax pooled account-level F1 of the isolated mode on the calibration window; ties -> higher threshold

engine.name: IBM-scale vectorised variant of D1 flow-through+ / D5 rare-exit concentration (own design)

fitted_reference_model.note: evaluation-only; fitted on calibration labels; not used for any flag
